note: Acceptance scenarios (Anthropic skill-creator convention; no standard runner yet). Adapt {{PLACEHOLDERS}} to your corpus.

evals.name: estimate-then-yield-happy
evals.prompt: Run /extract-source on a born-digital text PDF after declaring an extraction_estimate.
expect: extraction_estimate is written to frontmatter BEFORE extraction
extraction is deterministic (pdfplumber/Docling), not an LLM bulk pass
extraction_yield recorded after; yield ~ matches estimate, source not flagged shallow

evals.name: shallow-extraction-caught
evals.prompt: Run /extract-source on an image-only PDF routed (wrongly) through the text recipe.
expect: source marked extraction: shallow and queued for the scanned/OCR recipe
it does NOT pass as 'done' into the trusted set

evals.name: classify-by-structure-not-name
evals.prompt: Run /extract-source --type auto on a workbook named 'summary.xlsx' that is actually formula-dense.
expect: type/classification is decided on scanned structure (formula density), not the filename (incident D4)
routes to the xlsx formula-graph recipe, not a data-only read

evals.name: ace-success-denominator-excludes-hard-exclusions
evals.prompt: Run /extract-source on an ACE bounded sample with hard exclusions and successful routed items.
expect: uses eligible_candidate_items as the success denominator
